description: Inspect an image from the current conversation using this agent’s assigned Image In role.

config.worker_instruction: Answer the user's specific request about this image — focused, factual, and concrete. Only add surrounding detail if it helps that answer. If no specific request was made, give a clear general description.

guidance.switch_available: Inspect current-conversation images through process_image using the assigned Image In role. Ask a precise question. If that role or its connection is unavailable, report it; never silently substitute Standard or invent visual details.
guidance.describe_only: NOTE: your current model cannot see images, so a vision model's description of the attached image has been added below. Answer from it. If you need a sharper detail, call process_image with a precise, narrow question (you can call it again with an even tighter question).
guidance.not_enabled: An image was attached ({names}) but your Image Vision ability is not enabled, so you cannot see images. Tell the user plainly that your Image Vision ability is turned off and that an admin can enable it for this agent (Agent Settings → Abilities → Image Vision). Do NOT say it is a limitation of your model, and do NOT guess, invent, or describe the image's contents.
guidance.no_vision_model: An image was attached ({names}) but no vision model is configured, so your Image Vision ability has nothing to look at the image with. Tell the user plainly that image viewing isn't set up and that an admin can add a vision model in App Config → Models (tick In on a vision-capable model). Do NOT guess, invent, or describe the image's contents.

migration_note: Native V3 implementation. Current schemas, live policy and configured model/module availability determine callable behavior.
